description: Whiteshadow (白影) in Phantom Blade Zero - weapon class, slot, stats, combo contribution and how to obtain it, with unconfirmed numbers left marked as unconfirmed.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Whiteshadow (白影) is a two-handed blade in Phantom Blade Zero's primary weapon set. Requires four masks plus the Blizzard Blademaster, so it is the most gated weapon on the list and ties directly into the true ending checklist.

sections.title: Weapon Class and Slot
sections.content: Whiteshadow (白影) occupies the Primary slot, and it is classed as Two-handed. Soul carries two primary blades and two secondary Phantom Edges at once, and switching between the four refills stamina rather than costing it - which is what keeps a combo chain running. Sha-chi is a separate pool, spent on heavy attacks and blocks. The full class lists are on the blade index.

sections.title: Stats and Effects
sections.content: Not confirmed post-launch. Phantom Blade Zero does not publish a numeric stat sheet for individual weapons, and no measurement of this one has been recorded, so no damage, scaling or speed figure is given here. A number invented from how the weapon looks is exactly the kind of filler this page exists to avoid.

sections.title: How It Plays
sections.content: Not confirmed post-launch. No verified note on how this weapon behaves inside a combo has been published, so nothing is written here.

sections.title: How to Obtain
sections.content:
Meigu Lake, Whiteshadow's Fall (four masks + Blizzard Blademaster).

Dropped by Blizzard Blademaster - see that page for the fight itself, and boss drops for the reverse list.

Gated behind: Four retainer masks plus the Blizzard Blademaster.

Acquisition points are taken from the acquisition table on the weapons hub, which is kept in step with this page - if a route is corrected there, it is corrected here.
